\"我想設計一套系統，讓迷路的人找得到方向。\": "I want to design a system that helps lost people find their way."
\"我想建立一個結構，讓想法能穩穩落地。\": "I want to build a structure that lets ideas land steadily."
\"我擅長把混亂裡的線索，整理成大家用得上的語言。\": "I'm good at turning the clues in a mess into language everyone can use."
\"我蓋的不是高塔，而是一座讓人記得來路的橋。\": "I'm not building a tall tower; I'm building a bridge that helps people remember where they came from."
\"我願意站在最前面，先接住還沒被整理的大量資訊。\": "I'm willing to stand at the front and catch the flood of information no one has sorted yet."
\"我想設計一個介面，讓人重新和自己對話。\": "I want to design an interface that helps people talk with themselves again."
\"我搭的不只是一套方法，而是一群人一起生活的基礎。\": "I'm not just building a method; I'm laying the ground a community can live on."
\"我專注把心裡的願望，變成真的做得到的步驟。\": "I focus on turning the wishes in my heart into steps that can really be done."
\"我不需要被看見，我想讓好的方法可以被複製、傳下去。\": "I don't need to be seen. I want good methods to be copied and passed on."
\"我想建立一套共同的語言，讓想法相近的人認出彼此。\": "I want to build a shared language that lets like-minded people recognize each other."
\"我天生是架橋的人，把兩邊的智慧接在一起。\": "I'm a natural bridge-builder, joining the wisdom on both sides."
\"我想把那些還沒被寫下來的經驗，整理成可以用的語言。\": "I want to turn experience no one has written down yet into language people can use."
\"我想讓情緒成為指引，而不是枷鎖。\": "I want emotions to be a guide, not a cage."
\"我聽得見話語背後藏著的感受。\": "I can hear the feelings hidden behind the words."
\"我想陪伴那些來不及說出口的悲傷。\": "I want to keep company with the sadness that never got said."
\"我能從沉默裡，聽出你沒說出口的需要。\": "I can hear, in silence, the need you didn't say."
\"我想陪你學會好好愛自己，不再壓抑。\": "I want to help you learn to love yourself well and stop holding back."
\"我想幫人打開和自己內在的對話。\": "I want to help people open a conversation with their inner selves."
\"我給的不是答案，而是讓你看見自己的方法。\": "I don't give answers; I give you a way to see yourself."
\"我想為每一道裂縫，帶進理解和柔軟的光。\": "I want to bring understanding and soft light into every crack."
\"我陪你走過轉折，不急著改變你。\": "I walk with you through turning points, without rushing to change you."
\"我感覺得到細微的變化，陪你找回內在的一致。\": "I can sense small shifts and help you find your way back to being whole inside."
\"我想守住一個空間，讓情緒可以自在流動。\": "I want to hold a space where feelings can move freely."
\"我是那個在風暴裡，依然保持溫柔的人。\": "I'm the one who stays gentle in the middle of a storm."
\"我想把最黑暗的經驗，轉成可以照路的光。\": "I want to turn the darkest experiences into light that shows the way."
\"我願意走進混亂，把秩序和真相帶出來。\": "I'm willing to walk into chaos and bring order and truth out of it."
\"我是改變發生的地方，也是讓真相浮現的那股推力。\": "I'm where change happens, and the push that lets the truth come up."
\"我接得住還沒走完的情緒，讓它慢慢鬆開。\": "I can hold feelings that haven't finished moving, and let them slowly loosen."
\"我想接住那些還沒被接納的部分。\": "I want to hold the parts that haven't been accepted yet."
\"我熟悉痛和破碎，因為那常常是重新開始的入口。\": "I know pain and brokenness well, because they're often the doorway to starting again."
\"我說的話，是用來拆穿謊言、修補裂縫的。\": "My words are for exposing lies and mending cracks."
\"每一次崩塌，都是我重新設計路線的時候。\": "Every collapse is when I redesign the route."
\"我是來轉化的，不是來毀滅的。\": "I'm here to transform, not to destroy."
\"我願意陪著過程發生，而不是掌控結果。\": "I'm willing to stay with the process instead of controlling the result."
\"大家扛不住的，我願意分擔一些。\": "What others can't carry, I'm willing to share some of."
\"我想為那些還沒有名字的黑暗，找到出口。\": "I want to find a way out for the darkness that doesn't have a name yet."
\"我是一座橋，連起看得見和看不見的東西。\": "I'm a bridge between what can be seen and what can't."
\"我聽得見沒說出口的話，也能翻譯還沒被理解的語言。\": "I can hear what isn't said, and translate a language no one has understood yet."
\"我想讓光，照進更深的黑暗。\": "I want light to reach into deeper darkness."
\"我的感覺常常走得很遠，但我選擇讓它落回日常。\": "My feelings often travel far, but I choose to bring them back to everyday life."
\"我的身體像一根很靈敏的天線，感覺常常比語言先到。\": "My body is like a sensitive antenna; feelings often arrive before words."
\"我接得住還沒成形的念頭，也能穩穩地把它帶出來。\": "I can catch thoughts before they take shape and bring them out steadily."
\"我在語言和沉默之間，翻譯一個人真正的意思。\": "Between words and silence, I translate what a person really means."
\"我腦中常有很多畫面和靈感，也願意把它們翻譯成大家聽得懂的話。\": "My head is often full of images and ideas, and I'm willing to translate them into words others understand."
\"我相信自己的直覺，即使一時還說不出理由。\": "I trust my intuition, even when I can't explain why yet."
\"我懂得分寸：讓人安穩，而不是一次打開所有的門。\": "I know the right measure: help people feel steady instead of opening every door at once."
\"我想重新架起一座橋，讓人聽見自己內在的聲音。\": "I want to rebuild a bridge so people can hear their own inner voice."
\"我想叫醒還在等待的人，送出「可以開始了」的訊號。\": "I want to wake the people who are still waiting and send the signal that it's time to start."
\"我想說的話，不只用嘴說，更用走的、做的、活出來。\": "I don't just say what I mean; I walk it, do it and live it."
\"我用行動說話，用雙腳把訊息帶到每個地方。\": "I speak through action and carry the message everywhere on my own two feet."
\"我能在混亂中保持清楚，因為我跟著心裡的聲音走。\": "I stay clear in chaos, because I follow the voice inside me."
\"我不等萬事俱備，我知道「往前一步」就是開始。\": "I don't wait until everything is ready; I know one step forward is the start."
\"我是那個走在最前面的人。\": "I'm the one who walks out in front."
\"我從不強迫誰改變，但我一出現，改變就開始了。\": "I never force anyone to change, but when I show up, change begins."
\"我不是來討好每個人，而是把該傳的訊息準確送到。\": "I'm not here to please everyone; I'm here to deliver the message accurately."
\"我心裡有自己的方向，不需要別人批准。\": "I have my own direction inside and don't need anyone's approval."
\"我知道什麼時候該靠近、什麼時候該退，因為我讀得懂現場。\": "I know when to come close and when to step back, because I can read the room."
\"我想為大家打開一段新的旅程。\": "I want to open a new journey for everyone."
\"我在，就是一種穩定的力量。\": "Just being here is a steady kind of strength."
\"我不急著說話，因為我知道安靜也是一種引導。\": "I'm in no hurry to speak, because I know quiet can guide too."
\"我習慣先觀察，等大家穩下來，再讓事情開始流動。\": "I watch first, wait for everyone to settle, and then let things start to flow."
\"當所有人都在動，我的安靜是大家回來的依靠。\": "When everyone is moving, my quiet is what they come back to."
\"我讀得懂空氣裡細微的變化，和情緒的漣漪。\": "I can read small shifts in the air and the ripples of emotion."
\"我是接住改變的人，也是守住空間的人。\": "I'm the one who catches change and the one who keeps the space."
\"我用呼吸感受，用安靜回應。\": "I feel with my breath and answer with quiet."
\"只要我在場，就有一種安定感慢慢散開。\": "When I'm in the room, a sense of calm slowly spreads."
\"我不需要跳進混亂，我只要好好穩住自己。\": "I don't need to jump into the chaos; I only need to stay steady myself."
\"我的穩不是慢，是讓改變有地方生根。\": "My steadiness isn't slowness; it gives change a place to take root."
\"當劇烈的變動來臨，我是最後那道穩住大家的牆。\": "When big upheaval comes, I'm the last wall that keeps everyone steady."
\"我的慢，是另一種節奏的真實。\": "My slowness is the truth of a different rhythm."
\"我看見每個人身上的一小塊，正在等待被拼在一起。\": "I see a small piece in each person, waiting to be fitted together."
\"我想找的不只是一個人，而是讓整張網連起來。\": "I'm not looking for just one person; I want to connect the whole web."
\"我讀得懂人與人之間，沒說出口的連結。\": "I can read the unspoken connections between people."
\"我感覺得到一個團隊沒說出來的狀態。\": "I can feel what a team isn't saying."
\"我知道誰適合在哪個位置，什麼時候該被接上。\": "I know who fits where, and when they should be brought in."
\"我說的話，能讓分散的人找回共同的方向。\": "What I say helps scattered people find a shared direction again."
\"我是一塊拼圖，同時也是放拼圖的那張板子。\": "I'm one piece of the puzzle, and also the board the puzzle sits on."
\"我幫大家看見彼此，也看見自己。\": "I help people see each other, and see themselves."
\"我的直覺常常不只是為了自己，而是為了大家。\": "My intuition is often not just for me but for everyone."
\"我是調和的人，能在衝突裡找到大家都走得過去的那條路。\": "I'm a harmonizer who can find, in conflict, the path everyone can walk."
\"當所有人亂成一團時，我記得我們為什麼聚在一起。\": "When everything falls apart, I remember why we came together."
\"我想讓大家，可以好好地在一起。\": "I want everyone to be able to be together, well."
\"我是記錄者，不是旁觀者，我把真實的事傳下去。\": "I'm a recorder, not a bystander; I pass on what really happened."
\"我的筆記，是我和自己許下的承諾。\": "My notes are a promise I make to myself."
\"我寫的不只是事件，而是事情背後的起伏與感受。\": "I don't just write down events; I write the ups and downs and feelings behind them."
\"每一段經歷都有它的道理，我替它把道理留下來。\": "Every experience has its reason, and I keep that reason for it."
\"我記錄，是為了讓未來的人記得自己從哪裡出發。\": "I record so that people in the future remember where they started."
\"我會留意夢、想像和真實經驗之間重疊的地方。\": "I pay attention to where dreams, imagination and real experience overlap."
\"我寫的不只是你，也是那個「你以為不存在」的你。\": "I'm not only writing about you, but about the you that you thought didn't exist."
\"我想讓那些發光的故事，留下可以追尋的線索。\": "I want the stories that shine to leave clues others can follow."
\"我用時間記錄，但我寫下的，會留得比時間更久。\": "I record with time, but what I write will last longer than time."
\"我把感受寫成文字，也讓文字回到真實的生活。\": "I turn feelings into words, and let words return to real life."
\"我的記錄不是冷冷的旁白，而是人與人相遇的回聲。\": "My records aren't cold narration; they're the echo of people meeting people."
\"每一筆記錄都是一段傳承，我只是那條安靜的河流。\": "Every record is something handed down; I'm just the quiet river."
\"我感覺得到你沒說出口的情緒，那才是真正的訊息。\": "I can feel the emotion you didn't say, and that's the real message."
\"我不是來評斷你，而是讓你看見自己看不到的那一面。\": "I'm not here to judge you, but to help you see the side of yourself you can't see."
\"我想讓每一段關係，都成為認識自己的機會。\": "I want every relationship to be a chance to know yourself."
\"我願意暫時被你誤解，因為我知道你終究會看見。\": "I'm willing to be misunderstood for a while, because I know you'll see in the end."
\"我常感受到別人說不出口的痛，現在我正在學會不再全部扛起。\": "I often feel pain others can't put into words, and I'm learning not to carry all of it."
\"我在關係裡認識自己，也陪你想起你是誰。\": "I come to know myself in relationships, and help you remember who you are."
\"我願意當那個不逃走的人，只為了打開彼此之間的門。\": "I'm willing to be the one who doesn't run, just to open the door between us."
\"我知道，最深的真相常常藏在最怕被碰到的地方。\": "I know the deepest truth is often hidden where we're most afraid to be touched."
\"我的界線是為了保護愛，不是為了把人推開。\": "My boundaries are there to protect love, not to push people away."
\"我從你對待我的方式，看見你怎麼對待自己。\": "From how you treat me, I see how you treat yourself."
\"經過誤解和傷害之後，我仍然選擇愛。\": "After misunderstanding and hurt, I still choose love."
\"每一次靠近或遠離，都是兩個人之間在說話。\": "Every move closer or further away is two people talking."
\"我聽得出表面底下的訊號，也想把它們接起來。\": "I can hear the signals beneath the surface, and I want to connect them."
\"我不只是傳資料，而是讓資料有溫度地流動。\": "I don't just pass data along; I let it flow with warmth."
\"我把複雜的技術，翻譯成一般人用得上的工具。\": "I translate complex technology into tools ordinary people can use."
\"我想讓不同的系統，真的能彼此對話。\": "I want different systems to truly talk to each other."
\"我想讓技術回到它本來的樣子：服務人，而不是取代人。\": "I want technology to go back to what it was meant for: serving people, not replacing them."
\"我懂程式，也懂你心裡那種接不上線的失落。\": "I understand code, and I understand that lonely feeling of not being able to connect."
\"每一筆數據背後，都藏著一個想被理解的人。\": "Behind every piece of data is a person who wants to be understood."
\"我想設計一種語言，讓很複雜的東西也能用人話說清楚。\": "I want to design a language that makes even very complex things clear in plain words."
\"我做工具，不是為了讓人依賴，而是把選擇權交回每個人手上。\": "I make tools not so people depend on them, but to hand the choice back to each person."
\"當科技變得冰冷，我想讓它重新有溫度。\": "When technology turns cold, I want to make it warm again."
\"我想幫好的東西找到合適的載體，讓它不再流失。\": "I want to help good things find the right vessel, so they're no longer lost."
\"我相信，人可以和工具一起，活出更自由的生活。\": "I believe people and tools together can live a freer life."
\"我看得見未來的藍圖，也願意當第一個走上去的人。\": "I can see the blueprint of the future, and I'm willing to be the first to walk onto it."
\"我看見的不是幻想，而是還沒實現的可能。\": "What I see isn't fantasy; it's what's possible but hasn't happened yet."
\"我想點燃別人還不敢碰的夢。\": "I want to light up the dreams others don't dare to touch."
\"我知道這條路沒人走過，所以我選擇先走第一步。\": "I know no one has walked this road, so I choose to take the first step."
\"我不等條件完美，先把新的局面打開。\": "I don't wait for perfect conditions; I open up the new situation first."
\"我的創作來自心裡很深的召喚，不為證明，只為創造。\": "My creating comes from a deep call inside, not to prove anything, only to create."
\"我想為這個世界，打開一條全新的路。\": "I want to open a brand-new road for this world."
\"我是風暴裡定住方向的人，也是星圖上指路的光。\": "I'm the one who holds the course in a storm, and the light on the star map that shows the way."
\"我不留在過去，也不只等待未來，我是讓現在動起來的引擎。\": "I don't stay in the past or just wait for the future; I'm the engine that moves the present."
\"當大家還在觀望時，我已經開始改變。\": "While everyone is still watching, I've already started changing."
\"我的選擇不一定需要大家同意，但總會有人產生共鳴。\": "My choices don't always need everyone's agreement, but someone always resonates."
\"我願意走進黑暗，因為我知道那裡終究會亮起來。\": "I'm willing to walk into the dark, because I know it will light up in the end."
\"我的身體是一座橋，把看不見的感覺，變成看得見的動作。\": "My body is a bridge, turning feelings no one can see into movements everyone can."
\"我讓節奏變得有感覺，讓大家的狀態被看見。\": "I make rhythm something you can feel, so everyone's state can be seen."
\"當我開始跳舞，整個空間就重新活了起來。\": "When I start to dance, the whole space comes alive again."
\"我的聲音能帶路，傳遞那些還沒說出口的真實。\": "My voice can lead the way, carrying truths no one has said yet."
\"我感覺得到空氣的震動，也聽得見心跳的節奏。\": "I can feel the air vibrating and hear the rhythm of a heartbeat."
\"我想讓每個人，都唱出屬於自己的聲音。\": "I want everyone to be able to sing in their own voice."
\"沉默也有節奏，我聽得見沒說出口的律動。\": "Silence has rhythm too; I can hear the pulse no one speaks."
\"當大家忘了身體的語言，我願意當那個記得的人。\": "When everyone forgets the language of the body, I'm willing to be the one who remembers."
\"我不只是演奏的人，我本身就是一件樂器。\": "I'm not only the one who plays; I am an instrument myself."
\"當我和節奏合而為一，一切就回到最初的和諧。\": "When I become one with the rhythm, everything returns to its first harmony."
\"我想把心裡的旋律，用身體跳出來。\": "I want to dance the melody in my heart."
\"每一次呼吸，都是一段和世界同步的樂章。\": "Every breath is a movement in sync with the world."
